eia.title: Bataan-Cavite Interlink Bridge Project — Final Updated Environmental Impact Assessment Report
eia.preparedBy: T.Y. Lin International – Pyunghwa Engineering Consultants joint venture
eia.indexedSection: Baseline Conditions, Anticipated Impacts and Prescribed Mitigation (Water), Labac River “Fish and fishing” summary, PDF page 6-11
eia.reportedUse: Subsistence fishing, as summarized by the EIA.
eia.sourceScope: The excerpt places the summary under the Labac River heading but does not identify a station or reach. A separate lower-river habitat statement is not used to locate the fish reports.
eia.eiaStudyPeriod: The overall updated EIA study ran from 2021 to 2023 according to the project page; this is not a fish collection or catch date.
eia.diversityCaveat: The report says the survey likely underestimates diversity because portions of the estuary have mangrove patches.
eia.interpretation: A secondary-to-field report of fish used for subsistence, not a station-dated specimen record, standardized survey, current-presence result, or complete inventory.

rights.decision: Research-only minimal attribution; no report prose, table, map or image is reproduced and no public application projection is approved.

gbifScreen.interpretation: Zero indexed text-field results for these submitted Labac/watershed/alias strings. Not fish-absence evidence, an exhaustive search, or evidence that the EIA-reported names are incorrect.

limitations: The report date does not establish when the fish were caught or observed.
No station coordinate, reach, sampling gear, identification procedure, voucher or individual catch date was available in the indexed excerpt.
The report is not a complete fish inventory and explicitly notes likely underestimation.
Direct access to the official PDF returned HTTP 403; this review relies on the indexed official excerpt and does not retain a local copy.
GBIF searches cover only the specified text fields, candidate strings, country, taxon key and index state; zero results do not establish absence.
Reuse terms remain unverified; no species projection, fishing legality, safety, diet or catchability claim is approved.
nextAction: Request the 2014 CvSU “Identification and Characterization of Fish Species in Labac River” study or author-approved copy; verify its sampling dates, stations, capture/identification methods, vouchers and reuse terms. Keep both EIA names as unprojected leads until this and independent taxonomy/locality review are complete; continue dated station-level searches for Bacoor and Cavite San Juan.
